<function name="SetContents" parent="DTooltip" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
What Panel you want put inside of the <page>DTooltip</page>

<note>You can only have one Panel at a time; use Parenting to add more</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="panel" type="Panel">Contents</arg>
		<arg name="delete" type="boolean" default="false">If set to true, the panel in the first argument will be automatically removed when <page>DTooltip</page> is closed via <page>DTooltip:Close</page>.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
